name: harness-engineering-coding-agent
title: Harness Engineering Coding Agent
description: Portable executable control-plane workflow for AI coding agents: scoped run contracts, task DAGs, leases, permissions, evidence, independent verification, rollback, release safety and resumable state.
author: André Almeida

network_egress.reason: The host agent may inspect repositories, official references, CI and deployment evidence; network remains deny-by-default per run.

subprocess.reason: The package validators and target engineering workflows execute scoped test, Git and build commands.

dependency_install.reason: The harness package is standard-library only; target-project dependency changes require separate review.
